skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts, purposes, roles, and significance of comparative law, and be able to classify legal systems around the world.
Develop research skills to explore legal knowledge from a comparative perspective.
Apply critical thinking to analyze legal issues and solutions from different legal systems.
Analyze legal solutions from different legal systems to make informed decisions.
Work independently and in teams, and develop presentation skills.
Solve legal problems by applying knowledge from different legal systems.
Understand the formation and development of major legal systems around the world.
Compare and contrast legal systems to identify similarities and differences.
Evaluate legal solutions from different systems for the same legal issue.
Propose and initiate research on legal issues.
Plan and execute research to solve legal issues.
Be open to new ideas and respect differences.
Develop skills to present research findings effectively.
